rotation_function.name: public.rotate_active_question()
steps: Deactivate every question WHERE is_active=true AND end_date<current_ts; count changed rows.
Continue only if at least one question was deactivated.
Activate one inactive question with the earliest start_date greater than the end_date of a remaining active question, or greater than current_ts if no active question remains.
Insert question_rotation_logs with deactivated_questions=count, activated_question_id=selected id, success=true.
Exception handler attempts to insert success=false/error_message=SQLERRM and reraises; transaction rollback can discard that log.
limitations: No activation when zero expired active questions were deactivated.
A successful log may have a null activated_question_id if no matching next question exists.
Selection can activate a question whose start_date is in the future.
